maddeler.e:
نمتعض (form VIII)
# نَمْتَعِضُ (namtaʕiḍu) /nam.ta.ʕi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# نُمْتَعَضُ (numtaʕaḍu) /num.ta.ʕa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# نَمْتَعِضَ (namtaʕiḍa) /nam.ta.ʕi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# نُمْتَعَضَ (numtaʕaḍa) /num.ta.ʕa.dˤ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
